prompts.title: Director's Monitor and Scene Review
prompts.description: Behind-the-scenes coverage of a director reviewing a take with the camera team.
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 documentary-style BTS video on a professional film set. Follow the director as they review the lead actor's take on a calibrated director's monitor, then confer with the cinematographer and focus puller before the next take. Show authentic camera rig details, motivated practical lighting, restrained handheld movement, realistic crew behavior, no legible screen text, no logos.

prompts.title: Professional Dolly Move on Set
prompts.description: A filmmaking setup demonstrating a controlled dolly move and precise focus pull.
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 BTS shot of a professional cinema camera moving along a short dolly track toward the same lead actor. The operator performs a smooth push-in while the focus puller keeps the actor's eyes sharp; reveal the matte box, follow-focus, track marks, and crew working naturally. Stable horizon, motivated camera movement, realistic lens behavior, no text, no logos.

prompts.title: Studio Lighting for a Product Take
prompts.description: Studio crew balance a soft key, reflector fill, and rim light for a commercial shot.
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 behind-the-scenes studio video for a premium product commercial. Show the gaffer adjusting a large diffused key light, white reflector fill, and subtle rim light while the cinematographer checks exposure on the director's monitor. Preserve safe equipment placement, realistic soft shadows, controlled product highlights, natural crew movement, no legible monitor text, no logos.

prompts.title: Three-Scene 30-Second Product Film
prompts.description: A connected three-scene commercial template with locked character identity.
prompts.prompt:
Create a vertical 9:16, 30-second cinematic advertisement for [PRODUCT], starring [CHARACTER].
Scene 1 (0-10s): Introduce the same character and product in a clear location with a slow dolly-in.
Scene 2 (10-20s): Continue the action seamlessly with a lateral tracking move as the character demonstrates the product.
Scene 3 (20-30s): Resolve the action with a gentle crane reveal and a clean product hero frame.
Consistent Character Parameters: Preserve the exact same face, facial features, age, skin tone, hairstyle, body shape, wardrobe, and identity throughout all scenes. Keep camera direction, lighting continuity, and screen position consistent. No extra text, no logos.

prompts.title: Rainy Alley Cinematic Chase
prompts.description: A tightly framed chase with practical lighting, controlled camera movement, and safe action blocking.
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic action sequence through a rain-slick old-city alley. Track backward ahead of a determined runner as practical headlights sweep across the walls; use one controlled whip-pan to reveal the empty route behind. Grounded stunt movement, safe distances, believable rain reflections, motivated handheld camera, crisp subject focus, no collisions, no text, no logos.

prompts.title: The Sealed Cup Sketch
prompts.description: A visual comedy beat built around a simple misunderstanding and a clear reaction.
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 light workplace comedy. A person confidently presents an empty takeaway cup, pauses, then notices the lid is still sealed around the straw; let the camera hold for a clean reaction beat before a gentle push-in. Natural expressive acting, harmless physical comedy, warm office practicals, precise timing, readable facial reaction, no captions, no logos.

prompts.title: Stylized Traveler Animation Test
prompts.description: A short character animation test with consistent design, grounded foot contact, and expressive acting.
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 polished 3D character-animation test. A small stylized traveler walks across a sunlit studio set, pauses to inspect a map, then looks toward the camera. Preserve the exact character silhouette, colors, proportions, costume, and facial design throughout. Clear foot contact, balanced anticipation and follow-through, expressive eye movement, soft shadows, smooth camera truck, no text, no logos.

prompts.title: Slate, Camera Move, and Director Review
prompts.description: Behind-the-scenes coverage from the slate through a moving take to the director's monitor.
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic behind-the-scenes footage on a working film set. Begin with the assistant director marking a slate, follow the camera operator through a smooth short dolly move, then rack focus to the director reviewing the take on a calibrated monitor. Authentic crew coordination, practical studio lighting, safe cable placement, restrained documentary movement, no legible monitor text, no logos.
